args.common:
CONTEXT - Retrux hero, waterline anti-aliasing (20 Nov 2026, Asia/Jakarta time). Real-time three.js r184 / WebGL2 hero: ice rings above a mirror lake among snow, rocks, ice slabs and floes. Tiers: T0 phones (FXAA, plate lake), T1 desktop (MSAA 4, mirror lake LAKE_R12, half-size mirror target), T2. The user's words: "benerin pinggiran air di deket es itu kalo geser kamera kek low quality anti aliasing gitu, tapi dia aneh glitch gitu, make it smooth yaa" (the water edge near the ice looks like low-quality anti-aliasing when the camera moves, with a weird glitch; make it smooth) and today "priority benerin anti aliasing water yaa, ensure everything perfect". House rules: the user's words win; build nothing beyond the brief; look at your own images with the Read tool; report honestly.

HISTORY (read the LOGs; everything is mirrored under MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/)
  aa3/ (LOG.md, aa3.patch): AA3 = A tone-compressed resolve on the mirror lake (?aaresolve=0, also turns C off), B mirror redrawn every moving frame = the 20 Hz flash fix (?slabflash=0), C lake-edge TAA on the waterline band (?lktaa=0). Judged by 3 lenses (aa3/judge/*), one fix round (A-1 region-edge dashes fixed; far taps 3 px), rechecked: flash gone (also in the real rAF loop), no ghosting, texture, sky, switches, phones, Safari / Firefox all fine. OPEN after that round: per-box stepping at the near slab / rock waterlines; G7 cost +6.9..+10.4 % while moving (a separate AA5c perf track is working on it right now in lane aa5c :5195 - do not touch it); A-2 (TAA outliers at the governor's reduced render scales; the recheck says it REGRESSED after the fix round); A-3 (the compressed resolve's knee 0.5 darkens thin dark features beyond BASE and the 2x GT).
  aa5a/ (LOG.md, aa5a.patch vs aa3_judged): F1 glide = motion-adaptive history (0.85 at <= 0.15 px/frame -> 0.7 at >= 0.5 px/frame), AA3's clip and Catmull-Rom, no silhouette blur on band pixels while the TAA runs (band flagged by negative alpha), a still tail that ramps back exactly to AA3 at rest; switch ?lkglide=0 (== AA3). Its glide shaders are built from AA3's TAA_FRAG / EDGE_FRAG by exact text replacement that throws when an anchor is not found exactly once. Effect: the front-slab edge advances like the GT (crisper, without AA3's lumps); other boxes look like AA3; G4 against the blurred TAA-off frame counts the intended sharpening (90 px per Mpx-frame, balanced) but only 0.6 against the unblurred resolve.
  aa5b/ (LOG.md, aa5b.patch vs aa3_judged, Water.ts only): v3 far-floe guard = near a face's foot the walk reads the two bracketing rows of the half-size mirror target and gives a row lying farther than the front-most one the front-most row's colour (removes the floe's sunlit INSIDE that the oblique clip exposes under each foot - the cause of the pale block that popped in); switch ?ffblock=0 (== AA3). Pops vs GT: -41..-58 % px vs AA3, clusters removed 162 / added 22 (largest 33 px) on medium. The REST frame changes under the floes (10.6k px > 4 lv, moving toward the 2x GT).

LEAD DECISIONS (binding)
  L3 v3's rest-frame change under the floes is ACCEPTED: it removes a rendering error and moves toward the 2x GT. G3's rest clause is now 'identical to BASE except the intended edge smoothing and v3's under-floe reflection correction' - but every changed spot must look right at 1x (no new dark dashes, holes or bright columns).
  L4 G1's J rule: the lane's J32 / J48 reductions must be at least GT's minus 5 points; larger reductions are fine as long as G2 shows no lag, smear or trail.
  L5 G4 for F1 is measured against the unblurred resolve (?envedge=0) on band pixels: removing the band blur is intended sharpening. Required instead: no visible rim or outline at 1x and on a DPR-2 render, and no visible 'sharpness pumping' when the camera stops or starts (the tail ramps sigma 0.3 -> 0.6 over 24 still frames).
  L6 A-3: measure the compressed resolve's knee on the mirror-lake region (uAAKnee; e.g. 0.5 / 0.75 / 1.0, or a knee only for thin dark features) and pick the value that removes the over-darkening versus BASE / GT without losing G1; if none does, keep 0.5 and document why.
  L7 A-2: decide with images whether the reduced-scale TAA outliers are visible at 1x when the governor drops the render scale (0.9 / 0.8 / 0.7) while moving; if visible, they are a minor to fix.

GATES (summary): G1 MC32 >= 50 % lower than BASE slow / medium, >= 40 % fast / diag / reverse / leave (per box AND total), J rule L4; G1c glide (REL edge jerk vs GT, aa5a's tools) at least as good as AA5a; G2 no ghosting / trails / smear (fast sweeps, reversals, hold start / mid / release, re-press, pointer leaving, resize mid-motion, tab hidden -> visible, governor scale changes, DPR 2); G3 texture >= 0.95 of BASE (L3 for rest); G4 per L5; G5 hero, sky, clouds unchanged; G6 no periodic flash (stepped + real rAF with CDP mouse input); G7 not judged here (AA5c owns it; just report anything that adds cost); G8 switches exact (?lkglide=0 -> fixed AA3 + v3; ?ffblock=0 -> fixed AA3 + F1; both -> fixed AA3; ?aaresolve=0&slabflash=0&lktaa=0&lkglide=0&ffblock=0 == BASE; T0 and ?envlake=plate == BASE); G9 phones == BASE; G10 tsc clean, 0 console errors / warnings, DPR 1 and 2, resize, no first-motion hitch.

RIG: SP/work3/aa3/tools (cap.mjs stepped capture with paths slow / medium / fast / diag / reverse / leave / hold / rest, --qs, --port, --mask; crawl.mjs, phase.mjs, slice.mjs, strip.mjs, diffmap.mjs, ident.mjs / g8.sh, g10.mjs, mkpatch.sh, applytest.sh, lib.mjs); judges' tools SP/work3/judge/*/tools (real-loop capture, pin.mjs, fold.py, gov / tab / resize cases); aa5a's tools (bloom-free capm.mjs masks, glidecore / glide metric) in SP/work5/aa5a/tools and MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/aa5a/tools; aa5b's tools (popscan.mjs, popnew.mjs, bloom-free masks) in SP/work5/aa5b/tools and its backup. GT caps: SP/work3/aa3/caps/{slow,medium}_gt and SP/work5/aa5b/caps/reverse_gt (16-sample: BASE at 2880x1532 with ?lkmeach=1, 2x2 averaged). Copy tools into your own folder before changing them; they hard-code paths and ports.

PATHS
  SP = /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-muhamadrifaldi-Documents-GitHub-retrux-hero-rnd/a0f5735b-9a7f-477e-9b57-6de40ca5644b/scratchpad (a reboot wipes it: mirror your report and key images into MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/aa6/<your role>/ as you go)
  MAIN = /Users/muhamadrifaldi/Documents/GitHub/retrux-hero-rnd (never edit MAIN's code; its :3000 dev server is the user's preview - never stop it; write only under MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/aa6/)
  AA6 lane (integration) = /Users/muhamadrifaldi/Library/Caches/retrux-lanes/aa6/retrux-web (an APFS clone of aa3_fixed1), lab port 5196: cd <lane> && PORT=5196 nohup node hero-lab/serve.mjs --no-watch > <log> 2>&1 &  (rebuilds on start). Only the integrator and then the fixer may edit it or restart :5196.
  Frozen references (never edit): aa3_base = BASE (lab :5182, never stop), aa3_judged, aa3_fixed1 (= fixed AA3), aa5a and aa5b lanes (their final states), all under /Users/muhamadrifaldi/Library/Caches/retrux-lanes/ ; to serve a frozen reference for comparisons, clone it first (cp -c -R) and serve the clone on 5197 or 5198. Never touch aa3 (:5181), aa5c (:5195), aa3_demo (:3001) or :5180.
  Typecheck in a lane's retrux-web: npx tsc -p tsconfig.hero.json --noEmit && npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit --incremental false
MACHINE RULES (the user works in Photoshop / Figma on this M4 Mac): every headless browser goes through node SP/slot/slot.mjs run '<label>' -- <command> (2 slots shared by several agents; hold one <= ~5 min per batch). playwright-core via createRequire('/Users/muhamadrifaldi/Documents/GitHub/retrux-hero-rnd/hero-pipeline/tools/package.json'). ffmpeg /opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg (no PIL); python3 -I. No git commits / pushes, deploys, uploads or paid tools; never read or print .env; don't edit CLAUDE.md, memory or settings. Write logs as LOG.md (or LOG.txt if .md is refused).
args.integrator:
ROLE: INTEGRATOR. Build AA6 in the AA6 lane = aa3_fixed1 + aa5b.patch + aa5a.patch. Time box 60 min.
1. Apply aa5b.patch (Water.ts only; Water.ts is identical in aa3_judged and aa3_fixed1, so it should apply cleanly; verify with patch --dry-run first).
2. Merge AA5a into HeroEngine.ts and world/EnvEdge.ts with a 3-way merge per file: base = aa3_judged's file, ours = aa3_fixed1's file (it has the fix round's A-1 region checks and the 3-px far taps), theirs = the aa5a lane's file (git merge-file -p, then resolve by hand). AA5a builds its glide shaders from AA3's TAA_FRAG / EDGE_FRAG by exact text replacement: the fix round changed TAA_FRAG, so make sure every anchor is still found exactly once and that the glide variant carries the fix round's region checks too (glide on must still have A-1 fixed).
3. Prove the switches (ident.mjs-style: final image, all targets, all linked programs): ?lkglide=0 == aa3_fixed1 + v3; ?ffblock=0 == aa3_fixed1 + F1 (compare with a temporary clone built that way, or argue file by file and prove the two single-feature states by images on a medium capture); ?lkglide=0&ffblock=0 == aa3_fixed1; all five switches off == BASE; T0 and ?envlake=plate == BASE; tsc clean.
4. Prove the effects survived: F1's front-slab glide numbers and slices (as in aa5a's LOG) and v3's pop scan (as in aa5b's LOG) on medium, within noise of the originals.
5. Write aa6.patch vs BASE and aa6_vs_fixed1.patch; apply-test both on fresh clones (they must reproduce the lane exactly); mirror the patches and your LOG into MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/aa6/integrator/. Leave the :5196 lab running on the final AA6 build for the pre-judges.
args.prejudge: ROLE: independent, adversarial PRE-JUDGE of the integrated AA6 lane (lab :5196; BASE :5182). Read-only: never edit any lane, never restart :5196 or :5182 (if one is down, say so and restart only that lab with the documented command). Time box 75 min. Folder: SP/work6/<lens>; mirror evidence into MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/aa6/prejudge-<lens>/. Each finding: id (<lens initial>-n), severity, evidence (paths + numbers), exact repro, suggested fix. Look at every image you cite.

lenses.prompt: LENS = F1 GLIDE RISKS. (1) G2 with the higher history weights: fast sweeps, abrupt reversals, a 3-frame flick, pointer leaving and re-entering, hold press / mid / release / re-press, resize mid-motion, tab hidden -> visible mid-motion, governor scale changes 0.9 / 0.8 / 0.7 while moving, DPR 2 - stepped AND one real-rAF run with CDP mouse input; strips around each event, looked at. (2) L5: rims / outlines at 1x and DPR 2; sharpness pumping when the camera stops and starts (edge width over time across the 24-frame tail: is the change visible at 1x?). (3) L7 / A-2 in AA6: visibility of the reduced-scale outliers. (4) G1 per box (all six boxes, all six paths) and G1c vs AA5a's numbers. (5) G6 in the real loop. (6) First-motion hitch (first moving frames after load and after a long rest).

LENS = v3 REFLECTION RISKS + A-3. (1) Pop scan (aa5b's popscan / popnew with bloom-free masks) on ALL paths: slow, medium, fast, diag, reverse, leave, hold (press, dolly, release): list every cluster v3 adds vs fixed AA3 and every cluster left; look at the biggest ones at 1x and 4x. (2) Rest look (L3): AA6 vs fixed AA3 vs the 2x GT under every floe, at 1x and 4x - any new dark dash, hole, bright column or seam? (3) The hold: the wave-crest train and the rings' reflection near floes with v3. (4) G5 hero / sky; G3 texture. (5) L6 / A-3: measure uAAKnee on the mirror lake (live uniform: __hero.pipeline.aa.read.uAAKnee, or a lab-only switch) at 0.5 / 0.75 / 1.0 for thin dark features vs BASE and GT and for G1 (MC32 per box); recommend a value with images; this is a measurement for the lead, file it as a minor finding only if a better value clearly exists.

args.fixer: ROLE: FIXER of the AA6 lane after two pre-judges. Fix exactly the findings below - no new features, no change of approach, nothing about G7 cost (the AA5c track owns cost). For each: reproduce with the pre-judge's repro first, fix in the AA6 lane, re-measure with the same probe, look at before / after images. Every switch stays exact (re-prove all of G8 at the end: ?lkglide=0, ?ffblock=0, both, all five off == BASE, T0, plate). tsc clean. Regenerate aa6.patch vs BASE and aa6_vs_fixed1.patch, apply-test them, mirror them with a dated LOG into MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/aa6/fixer/. You own :5196 now. Time box 75 min. Leave a finding that needs a design change, and say why.
